# Gallery Zero

- Project: Gallery Zero. Read `docs/PRD.md` and `design/design.md` before any task.
- Backend: FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2, Alembic, layered architecture (routers/services/repositories/schemas/models). No logic in routers.
- Frontend: Next.js App Router, TypeScript strict, Tailwind using tokens from `design/design.md` only.
- Never hardcode colors, spacing, easing, or secrets. Never commit `.env` files.
- Every animation respects `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- Use the awwwards MCP only for inspiration and motion study. Never copy assets, text, or layouts from reference sites. Build original work.
- Use responseMode `"compact"` on searches to save tokens.
- Show a plan first for tasks touching more than 3 files.
